mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 650K units signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 650K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other market conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5pp in 2 months, it signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if payroll employment (PAYEMS) is also declining.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns during strengthening supply chain periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% in 1 quarter signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, especially if housing starts (HOUST) are also declining.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is above its 3-month moving average, it signals a potential inflationary pressure buildup, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 7%) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of other market conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns during strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in GDP (GDPC1) is above 2% and industrial production (INDPRO) is also increasing, it signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
